title: Vault Admission Standards for Safe Deposit Boxes: Identification, Hours and Named Persons
content:
Admission to a branch vault holding Safe Deposit Boxes is governed by the standards below. The first four stand the same for every box size.

| Standard | Value, all sizes |
| --- | --- |
| Government photo identification at every vault entry | required |
| When the vault may be entered | branch lobby hours |
| Most co-lessees on one rental | 1 |
| Most deputies authorized to access the box | 2 |
| Charge to add a co-lessee | $0.00 |

## Access by appointment outside lobby hours

Whether an appointment outside lobby hours is offered, and what it costs, depends on the size leased.

| Size | Appointment outside lobby hours | Charge per appointment |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 3x5 Safe Deposit Box | not offered | not applicable |
| 3x10 Safe Deposit Box | not offered | not applicable |
| 5x10 Safe Deposit Box | not offered | not applicable |
| 10x10 Safe Deposit Box | not offered | not applicable |
| 10x15 Safe Deposit Box | not offered | not applicable |
| 10x20 Safe Deposit Box | offered | $50.00 |

The 10x20 Safe Deposit Box is the one size for which an appointment outside lobby hours is offered, and it is accordingly the one size for which this tariff carries an appointment charge; on the other five sizes no charge is stated because no such appointment is offered.

**Named persons.** One rental admits at most one co-lessee and at most two deputies. Adding a co-lessee carries no charge, the figure being $0.00 for every size.
